import html # Predefined HTML structure for a blog post. # The placeholders {title} and {body} will be replaced by the sanitized heading # and description respectively. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def display_blog(heading: str, description: str) -> str: """ Prepare a user‑submitted blog post for safe web display. Parameters ---------- heading : str The main heading or subject of the blog post. description : str The complete textual content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and HTML‑formatted blog post, ready for secure presentation on a webpage. Notes ----- * The heading and description are escaped using `html.escape` to prevent injection of HTML or JavaScript. * Newlines in the description are converted to
tags so that paragraph breaks are preserved. * The function does not perform full Markdown or rich‑text parsing; it simply escapes and formats the raw text. """ if not isinstance(heading, str): raise TypeError("heading must be a string") if not isinstance(description, str): raise TypeError("description must be a string") # Escape special HTML characters to prevent injection. safe_heading = html.escape(heading, quote=True) # Escape description and preserve line breaks. safe_description = html.escape(description, quote=True).replace("\n", "
\n") # Format the final HTML using the predefined template. formatted_post = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_heading, body=safe_description) return formatted_post
